description: Figure 1 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the average performance and token usage for four large reasoning models (LRMs) across four benchmarks, comparing the proposed method CoUT against three baselines: CoT, CoD, and CCOT. The chart is structured with two vertical y-axes: the left axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 70 to 100 in increments of 5, and the right axis, labeled “Token Count”, ranges from 0 to 800 in increments of 100. The horizontal x-axis displays four groups of bars, each corresponding to one of the four benchmarks, with each group containing four bars representing the four methods. Within each group, the bars are colored and labeled as follows: the first bar is red for CoT, the second is orange for CoD, the third is light blue for CCOT, and the fourth is green for CoUT. The height of each bar indicates the accuracy percentage, with the exact values labeled on top: for the first group, CoT is 91.19%, CoD is 80.89%, CCOT is 88.50%, and CoUT is 88.40%. For the second group, CoT is 676.85 tokens, CoD is 534.24 tokens, CCOT is 445.91 tokens, and CoUT is 354.46 tokens. The bars are not sorted by value; instead, they are presented in the order of the methods as defined by the legend, with CoT consistently appearing as the tallest bar in the accuracy axis and the widest bar in the token count axis.
